enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the air conditioner set to a comfortable overnight temperature
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Air conditioner remains on. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust blanket. Sleep. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and brushing teeth with the water heater on
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off water heater. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast: toast with the toaster and tea with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Take out knife. Take out mug. Take out tea bag. Put tea bag in mug. Wait for kettle. Kettle boils. Pour water into mug. Remove tea bag. Stir tea. Toast pops up. Remove toast. Butter toast. Eat toast. Drink tea. Wipe mouth with napkin.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in work clothes, packing bag, checking phone for the day's patient schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out trousers. Take out socks. Take out underwear. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on trousers. Put on socks. Walk to mirror. Adjust shirt. Open bag. Put wallet in bag. Put keys in bag. Pick up phone. Open schedule app. Scroll through patient list. Close phone. Put phone in bag. Zip bag.

Put on shoes. Open door. Close door. Lock door. Walk down stairs. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Get up. Walk to door. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Push door. Enter hospital. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist: assessing patients, running rehabilitation exercises and manual therapy sessions in the hospital ward
enriched_activities.desc: Enter ward. Put on gloves. Wash hands. Greet first patient. Ask about pain. Assist patient to stand. Walk with patient. Guide leg exercises. Apply manual therapy to knee. Measure joint angle. Record data. Move to next patient. Demonstrate exercise. Correct patient's form. Provide manual resistance. Stretch patient's arm. Apply heat pack. Remove heat pack. Write clinical notes. Discuss with nurse.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break in the hospital staff room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to staff room. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch box. Close refrigerator. Open microwave. Place lunch box inside. Close microwave. Press start button. Wait. Microwave beeps. Open microwave. Take out lunch box. Close microwave. Sit at table. Open lunch box. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw away trash.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist: continuing patient treatment sessions, writing clinical notes and coordinating with the care team
enriched_activities.desc: Return to ward. Wash hands. Greet patient. Assist patient to walk. Guide exercises. Apply ultrasound. Adjust settings. Write notes. Talk to doctor. Attend meeting. Discuss care plan. Update patient records. Use computer. Type notes. Print reports. File papers.

Leave hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Get up. Walk to door. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter building. Walk to apartment door. Unlock door. Enter. Close door. Lock door. Take off shoes. Put on slippers.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and range hood, then eating at the table
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Turn on range hood. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off range hood. Take out plate. Serve food. Carry plate to table. Sit at table. Pick up chopsticks. Eat. Drink water. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, wiping the counters and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Stack plates. Carry to sink. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load utensils. Load cups. Close dishwasher. Add detergent. Press start. Pick up sponge. Wet sponge. Wipe counter. Rinse sponge. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on living room light. Turn on air conditioner. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Shift position. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Turn off air conditioner. Turn off living room light.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a warm shower and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Turn off water heater. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer and desk lamp to read physiotherapy articles and review patient treatment notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Turn on study light. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open browser. Search for articles. Read article. Take notes. Open patient notes. Review notes. Type notes. Save file. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off study light.

enriched_activities.activity: Bedtime wind-down: dimming the light, checking the phone and setting an alarm
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Dim light. Pick up phone. Check messages. Open alarm app. Set alarm. Put down phone. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Pull back blanket. Lie on bed. Pull blanket over. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Air conditioner remains on. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust blanket. Sleep. Remain asleep.
